identity.name: Eric Sawtelle
identity.role: Experimental AI Systems Designer & Agentic Engineer
identity.eyebrow: Experimental systems · agentic engineering · technical interfaces
identity.headline: I build systems where models, software, and people can actually work together.
identity.lede: My work branches across agent control planes, AI-native applications, model experiments, technical visualization, provenance systems, and practical human/AI workflows. The common thread is making hidden state visible, keeping authority explicit, and turning experiments into inspectable systems.
identity.availability: Independent builder · open to applied AI systems, agent engineering, developer tooling, and experimental product work

principles.title: Make invisible systems visible
principles.body: Turn model state, software structure, provenance, authority, and mathematical relationships into surfaces people can inspect.

principles.title: Separate reasoning from authority
principles.body: A model can propose, search, explain, or plan without silently acquiring permission to execute.

principles.title: Build from evidence outward
principles.body: Use hashes, receipts, tests, provenance, deterministic fixtures, and explicit claim boundaries as architecture—not cleanup.

principles.title: Cross boundaries deliberately
principles.body: Move between Kotlin, Go, Python, browser systems, native runtimes, symbolic math, and ML when the problem actually benefits from it.

branches.label: Agentic systems
branches.short: Control planes, model routing, bounded execution, persistent state.
branches.intro: I design agent systems as operating structures rather than giant prompts: distinct roles, scoped context, explicit handoffs, durable state, verification, and human authority where it matters.

branches.label: AI-native applications
branches.short: Products that treat model capability as part of the application architecture.
branches.intro: These projects integrate model and ML capabilities into real application workflows while keeping capability declarations, local state, replay, and failure behavior inspectable.

branches.label: Computational interfaces
branches.short: Interactive visual systems for mathematics, models, and complex state.
branches.intro: A recurring design goal is to turn abstract relationships into something navigable: atlases, matrices, graphs, microscopes, live renderers, and technical workstations.

branches.label: Knowledge & provenance
branches.short: Durable context, source lineage, project intelligence, and reusable evidence.
branches.intro: I build systems that preserve where information came from, how it changed, what an agent may infer from it, and how humans can inspect the same underlying project model.

branches.label: Evaluation & reliability
branches.short: Adversarial testing, grounded retrieval, temporal authority, and safety boundaries.
branches.intro: Evaluation was the foundation of my AI work and is now the verification layer underneath the larger systems: measure what actually happened, preserve caveats, and keep claims bounded by evidence.

branches.label: Human-centered AI
branches.short: Practical systems that shrink the knowledge gap between capable models and ordinary users.
branches.intro: Not every useful AI project should become a full-stack application. I also explore small, repeatable workflows that help people turn model capability into useful everyday outcomes.

projects.title: DonSquad
projects.summary: A local-first agent family that routes planning, implementation, verification, review, documentation, and deployment across bounded specialist roles.

projects.title: Kolmaf-AI Desktop
projects.summary: An experimental local-first control layer that keeps LLM reasoning, evidence, permission, execution, and independent runtime readback as separate responsibilities.

projects.title: Goblin Logic Manager
projects.summary: A compact development-agent system that separates stable model-neutral behavior from thin model-family overlays and keeps generated agents reproducible and auditable.

projects.title: Cosmosis Image Studio
projects.summary: A Kotlin + OPENRNDR image generation and editing workstation with immutable references, non-destructive lineage, capability-driven providers, native ML adapters, and deterministic offline smoke paths.

projects.title: LLM Tokenizer Lab
projects.summary: A lightweight visual tokenizer explorer for comparing segmentation and token density across OpenAI-style, DeepSeek, and clearly labeled Claude-proxy workflows.

projects.title: Sacred Computations
projects.summary: A provenance-first atlas that connects recurrences, ratios, geometry, SymPy, matrices, numerical kernels, and executable expressions through graph, route, source, and 3D matrix views.

projects.title: Fractal Studio
projects.summary: A Kotlin + OPENRNDR fractal explorer where Kotlin owns state and orchestration while a GPU shader owns per-pixel complex iteration, with deterministic animation and preset semantics.

projects.title: Fractal Chaos Coding Map
projects.summary: An offline-first map connecting fractal mathematics, chaos, algorithms, rendering, machine models, creative coding, routes, and Q-learning experiments without promoting generated links into truth.

projects.title: MM-manager
projects.summary: A local-first project model that turns repositories, references, notes, structural evidence, semantic overlays, and runtime traces into a shared human-and-agent observatory.
projects.signal: The project model around the model

projects.title: IngestWowww
projects.summary: A browser capture pipeline that turns live pages into durable, portable human/agent artifacts with normalized structure, NDJSON records, manifests, hashes, provenance, and inert capsule exports.

projects.title: Master ASH Catalog / ASH-WIKI
projects.summary: A static KoLmafia script compendium that keeps script bytes beside source, hash, credit, license evidence, generated metadata, indexes, and conservative risk signals.

projects.title: Safety-Aware RAG / Retrieval Evaluation
projects.summary: A 74-question benchmark for grounding, abstention, authority conflicts, unsupported requests, and live-state dependency with corrected BM25 score-direction caveats preserved publicly.

projects.title: Belief Lifecycle Engine
projects.summary: A deterministic experimental architecture for preventing previously correct but outdated beliefs from continuing to authorize actions in long-lived agents.

projects.title: AI Agent Red-Team Evaluation Guide
projects.summary: A defensive framework for testing tool-using AI agents across prompt injection, memory persistence, MCP/tool boundaries, canary design, evidence chains, and claim verification.

projects.title: DIY Monthly Newsletter Free
projects.summary: A step-by-step path for using an accessible coding model and GitHub Pages to create, host, and maintain a useful monthly newsletter without servers, subscriptions, or a full-stack build.
